children: Tilly's, Inc. reported results for the 13 weeks ended Aug 1, 2026, with revenue of $163.5M and diluted EPS of $0.27, marking year‑over‑year gains driven by stronger full‑price merchandise selling and growth in e‑commerce.
Revenue was $163.5M, compared with $151.3M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 8.1%.
Net income was $8.38M, compared with $3.17M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 164.7%.
Diluted EPS was $0.27, compared with $0.1 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 170%.
Net sales increased 8.1% for the quarter and 11.3% year‑to‑date, supported by stronger merchandise full‑price selling and fresher inventory.
E‑commerce grew 20.9% in the quarter and 25.2% year‑to‑date, representing about 21% of total sales and contributing to omni‑channel comparable sales gains.
Comparable store sales rose 12.1% for the quarter and 16.5% year‑to‑date, driven by improved traffic and product mix.
Gross margin expanded to 35.5% for the quarter (32.7% YTD) due to better product margins and operating leverage.
Store count was reduced to 220 from 232, lowering occupancy costs while management focused on inventory and distribution efficiency.
